tools.name: list_video_models
tools.description: List Stivio video models, supported settings and per-second credit rates. Public; no key needed.

tools.name: estimate_video_cost
tools.description: Validate settings and calculate the exact credit cost. Free; does not generate or reserve credits.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Read your spendable Stivio credit balance. Requires a key; does not reconcile or render videos.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload and moderate a PNG/JPEG/WebP image for video generation. Provide raw base64 (no data URL), maximum 3 MiB decoded. Use the returned url as imageUrl or lastFrameUrl. Requires a key. Clients with file/shell access can instead POST multipart file to https://stivio.ai/api/upload with the same Bear

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Start a paid video job with user approval and an exact expectedCredits quote. Required requestId deduplicates identical retries for 24h. Never use a new id to retry an uncertain submission. Returns taskId. For i2v upload the image first; for t2v select a -t2v model.

tools.name: get_video_status
tools.description: Check your own task. Poll no faster than every 10 seconds. On success returns videoUrl for the MP4; failures use Stivio's refund flow. Can finalize storage or refunds; requires a key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "upload_image" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
